_about: The N-400 (naturalization) packet (src/packet.py, src/naturalization.py): the firm's G-28 and the N-400 on top, then the evidence the N-400 Instructions (edition 01/20/25) ask for, by basis. The green card, and for a spouse-based filing the marriage certificate and proof of the spouse's citizenship; any criminal, court or immigration-court records (Part 9); Form N-648 for a disability exception; tax returns for a fee reduction. Built into its own files (packet_n400.pdf, packet_n400.json). The attorney approves titles and order.
title: N-400 application (naturalization)
requires_message: The client hasn't been processed yet: process the client first.

handwork.text: Photos: none for a client living in the United States (USCIS takes them at the biometrics appointment); two passport-style photos only for a client applying from outside the U.S. (N-400 Instructions).

exhibits.title: Marriage certificate, and any divorce decrees ending prior marriages (spouse-based filing)
Proof the spouse has been a U.S. citizen for 3 years (U.S. birth certificate, passport, or certificate)
Court records and dispositions for every arrest, citation or charge (Part 9, item 15)
Immigration court records (Notice to Appear and the court's final order)
Federal tax returns (fee reduction, or taxes owed)

leave_out.intake_questionnaire: The firm's own intake questionnaire: internal.

leave_out.i485: A completed USCIS form from an earlier filing, not part of this application.

leave_out.lease: Not asked for with the N-400 (unless the attorney uses it to show residence after a long trip).
